subject: Hosted sandbox access, endpoint rotation and rate clarifications
messages:
From: Kar​thik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex@finlytics.ai>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted sandbox access, endpoint rotation and rate clarifications

Hi Alex / Priya — great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and the immediate asks so we can keep momentum:

- You indicated a preference for testing against our Hosted API first to validate throughput and latency (vs Dedicated / Private).
- Primary constraints: peak burst of ~120 QPS for embedding/semantic search, PII-sensitive tensors for a subset of calls, and a desire to avoid an early Dedicated commitment.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) We provision a sandbox project with three endpoints (ingest, search, assistant) and a shared API key for your test team.
2) Provide baseline rate limits (sandbox defaults) and options to request higher caps for the evaluation window.
3) Share a short quickstart checklist + small SLA summary so your legal/infosec folks can kick off review.

Questions for you before we set the sandbox:
- Can you confirm whether the 120 QPS is sustained or burst? If sustained, over what windows (1m/5m)?
- Any IP allowlist or VPC egress requirements for the sandbox?
- Will you need access to prefix/KV caching behavior for the search workflow in the test?

I've looped in Monica and Stephanie for technical setup and SLA items — Monica will handle endpoint provisioning, Stephanie will coordinate any special access or temporary rate increases.

Thanks — if you confirm the QPS profile and any IP constraints, we can have the sandbox ready within 48 hours.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf (summary checklist), SLA-summary-2028.pdf (2-page overview)

From: Alex Torres <alex@finlytics.ai>
To: Kar​thik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@finlytics.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted sandbox access, endpoint rotation and rate clarifications

Thanks Karthik — appreciated the demo. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 120 QPS is a peak burst we might see for a couple of minutes during business hours (mainly search/embeds). Sustained load is closer to 20–30 QPS.
- For the sandbox we can start without strict IP allowlist; our test clients will run from a handful of dev machines and your default API key mechanism is fine. For any production evaluation we will ask about VPC egress.
- We do want to validate prefix/KV caching behaviors for the search pipeline (we expect many repeated prefixes on customer queries).

Security note: we have some PII in request payloads — how do you handle masked customer identifiers in Hosted (and do you offer a Private option if needed)?

We'll need the sandbox and rate guidance so our infra team (Priya) can run the load tests. If you can include a sample config for the three endpoints (ingest/search/assistant) with tokenization and expected latency targets, that would be great.

Happy to jump on a 30-minute follow-up early next week to align.

— Alex
Head of Platform | Finlytics

Date: Sat, 12 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted sandbox access, endpoint rotation and rate clarifications

Hi Alex / Priya — Monica here (Solutions). Quick answers and what we'll provision: 

- Sandbox endpoints: we will create three logical endpoints in your sandbox project: /v1/ingest, /v1/search, /v1/assistant. Each will be backed by a single model variant tuned for the workload (we'll document model name in the Drive link).
- Default sandbox rate caps: 60 requests/sec per endpoint (burst up to 150 req/sec for short windows, subject to fair-use). For your test profile that means search can burst to ~120 QPS — we can enable a temporary bump for scheduled load tests.
- Prefix/KV cache: we will enable a KV prefix cache on the /v1/search endpoint in sandbox so you can validate hit rates and latency improvements. We'll include a sample cache TTL and eviction config in the checklist.
- PII handling: Hosted retains request/response logs for 30 days by default for debugging; we can redact or disable retention for specific sandbox projects if you need. For production with strict PII requirements we can discuss Private (VPC/on-prem) or a Dedicated pool with custom retention.

Provision timeline and immediate items: 
1) I will create the sandbox project and issue a single API key (scoped) by EOD Monday.
2) I will attach the endpoint configs and a sample load test manifest to the Drive folder.
3) If you want a temporary rate bump for a scheduled 2-hour window, reply here with preferred times — we need at least 24 hours notice.

We will also include a short test plan (how to exercise cache hit/miss, and what latency targets to expect under the sandbox caps).

If you prefer, we can run the first load test with your team and watch metrics together (Monica live-run + Stephanie on rollout controls).

Thanks — Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: hosted-quickstart-checklist.pdf (contains sample configs), SLA-summary-2028.pdf
